definitions.explanation: The position exactly behind someone or something, in a straight line. One of the {真|ま}- direction words: {真|ま}ん{前|まえ} (right in front), {真上|まうえ} (directly above), {真横|まよこ} (right beside).

examples.japanese: {真後|まうし}ろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。

⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真後|まうし}ろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさかった→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧。
examples.english: At the cinema, the person in the seat directly behind me was noisy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{真後|まうし}ろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: When I turned around, my teacher was standing right behind me, and I was startled.

notes:
{真|ま} (exactly) + ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧ (behind).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真後|まうし}ろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ / ⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to stand / be right behind
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真後|まうし}ろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: the seat directly behind ~
- {真後|まうし}ろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧: to call out from right behind

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{前|まえ}→真ん前：30718_manmae⟧: right in front (the opposite; note the ん)
- ⟦{真上|まうえ}→真上：07784_maue⟧ / ⟦{真下|ました}→真下：07785_mashita⟧: directly above / below
- ⟦{真横|まよこ}→真横：16717_mayoko⟧: right beside
